title: Sustained-release oral morphine to alleviate persistent dyspnea in patients with chronic respiratory insufficiency due to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis outside the administration of ventilatory assistance: prospective multicenter randomized, placebo-controlled study, parallel arms (OPIDYS-ALS).
official: Sustained-release oral morphine to alleviate persistent dyspnea in patients with chronic respiratory insufficiency due to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis outside the administration of ventilatory assistance: prospective multicenter randomized, placebo-controlled study, parallel arms. (OPIDYS-ALS).
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to show that oral sustained-release morphine reduces the unpleasantness of the worst episode of dyspnea experienced during a given day, four weeks after inclusion in the study.
conditions: patients with chronic respiratory insufficiency due to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
